scope: Finite BMWE OpenData published response list for transmission-network subsidy2027–2029. External companies, associations, union and municipal umbrella included; Land government replies excluded from external denominator.
limits: Twenty-one previously examined public external responses,71physical PDF pages. Three Land replies are excluded; this is not a complete legislative-process or national population.

Inventories target material testable premises rather than every incidental factual assertion. Supported concerns the stated bounded proposition and version; unresolved is neither an error nor confirmation.

The official ministry dataset reports a5–13August consultation window. Authored dates, publication dates and actual delivery are distinct; one response is authored18August and BKM is undated. Current public draft bytes are not authenticated initial dispatch bytes.
Pure policy preferences and unconditional future outcomes are recorded in reading/exclusion audits; model attributions, conditional mechanisms and current causal premises remain assessable.
No author contact, human specialist confirmation, intent inference or representative error rate.
conclusions: All21archived public external responses and71physical PDF pages were independently re-read;188initial assessments each received a complete cross-review. Root independently adjudicated six omissions and added six bounded assessments.

No new error finding is admitted. The craft-tax candidate remains unresolved after a fresh final reviewer identified a reasonable narrower reading supported by the same sentence’s explicit producing-industry qualification. The legal category is clear; the author’s intended scope is not.

Primary tariff data, model reports and engineering evidence corroborate many bounded claims. Conditional network-cost forecasts are not treated as realised future facts; technical flexibility constraints are acknowledged without certifying industry-wide payback periods.

Existing retail pass-through duties are distinguished from immediate universal bill reductions. Current public legal/draft versions, later-August publications, claimed numerous-user incidence and exact investment start dates retain their specific applicability limits.
Supported and unresolved ledger assessments do not automatically enter the main issue files. Repeat reading adds zero units to the existing626-unit pool.
